tasks.t: Send Pierfrancesco the outline, the two-arm numbers and the questions (spokesperson, GLIMOS, author list)
Informal contact with Anna Selva / the Accelerator Division: AN2000 vs CN, 0.441 + 1.10 MeV at 1 µA, line and floor space, H2 2027
Get the INFN-AAI account + 'Risorse IT' (needed to submit on Indico)
Download the LNL LaTeX template from Indico; move the draft into it; upload to Overleaf
Ask the co-proponents (Massimi, Mengoni, Gervino, Gustavino, Cosentino) to join; collect names + affiliations
Draft v1 in Overleaf: abstract page + body of at most 4 pages (LNL template, 12 pt, figures and references included)
Draft to Pierfrancesco; agree the beam-day table and the machine
Circulate to co-proponents; comments by 7 Dec
Freeze text; fill the online Beam Time Request and Targets Request Form (keep the confirmation password)
Submit on Indico (event 50487). Deadline is 10 Dec 23:59 CET
Talk to the LNL ⁸Be spectrometer group (T. Marchi et al.) before submitting: how this complements their AN2000 data
PAC talk: 12 min + 8 min discussion; answer the technical-review points
Re-reduce the L10–L13 tables with two opposite arms (replace the ×2 scaling in two_arm_estimates.py)
Proposal figures: two-arm acceptance vs θ, expected spectra (441 keV and 1.10 MeV), rates table
Geant4: two-arm geometry with the real target holder and stand (MX17_Full_Geant branch from lnl_target)
Timing on cosmics: transit-corrected SiPM-wall/plastic resolution, arm-to-arm lag (decides TOF cut)
Ask Stephan / CEA: fix B's drift, new aluminised-mylar windows for A and B; dates
Ask CEA for the DREAM loan for H2 2027: 4 FEUs + TCM + 32 cables + LV; solder the TCM busy LEMO
Optional (high-budget upgrade): 4 CERN-design M1 cards for B. Slot 1 runs B with its existing Italian M1s
Cosmic bench, 2 MM + DREAM: efficiency, segment angle (μ ≲ 3°), noise with B's existing M1s
Find PMTs for the 4 small plastics (+2 for liquid cells if taken)
Digitizers: ~24 channels (16 wall + 4–6 PMT + trigger word) from LNL pool; else ask CAEN for a test loan
Trigger logic: 2–3 N1081B, a dual timer, FIFOs/splitters, NIM bin — borrow list
Bench tests T1, T2, T4 (prescaler, busy lock 1:1, trigger word)
Decide: bring 2 liquid cells? (×3.6 in reach at no cost if they work at LNL rates)
Target for the proposal: pressed Li on Cu (CN group), 10–12 µm; holder design (flat Al end cap at 45° or his Cu ogive)
Build the holder; make films; a week of LiOH-conversion test on the line
LNL access: registration ≥ 15 d ahead, RP training certificate, dosimeters, responsibility declaration
Safety file: Ar/iC₄H₁₀ 95/5 bottles in the hall, gas panel and exhaust (flammable)
Floor plan of the line: ~1.5 × 1.5 m around the target, beam height, cable path to the control room, network
Full chain on cosmics: 2 arms, DREAM + digitizers on one event list, run control, slow control Tier 1
Ship, install, commission on cosmics at LNL
8 beam days + beam-off cosmic nights; shift list sent to RP ≥ 3 days ahead
Which commission and when are the requests due? (Pierfrancesco wrote 'commission II'; INFN preventivi are usually prepared in summer: ask)
Full-experiment proposal (4 arms, big plastics) to the next LNL PAC, with the feasibility results

hardware.note: Best chamber: 92.9 % within 5 mm on the bench. Needs only the new aluminised-mylar window. Clean CERN M1 cards.
91.3 % on the bench; drift needs fixing (easy) + new window. Its M1 cards were the noisy Italian ones.
Spark-limited (57.8 %, 43.1 %); re-bulk needed. Not required for slot 1. C re-bulked would be the spare.
Clean CERN cards on A; B keeps its noisier Italian cards for slot 1. 4 new CERN-design cards for B are a high-budget upgrade toward slot 2 (~€2k each).
Half the n_TOF system. Solder a LEMO on the TCM busy output before the run (daq_trigger/PLAN.md §4.2).
4 FEUs at ~5 A + TCM ~5 A. HV: a CAEN unit driven by caen_hv_py.
16 of 20 bars read, ganged as at n_TOF on the summing boards: 8 channels per wall. Bias ~54 V, ~0.2 mA per wall.
The scintillators are available; the PMTs went back to the lender and must be found again.
67–76 % pile-up at n_TOF (γ-flash), so left out of the budget. LNL rates are far lower. With them the reach is ×3.6 better.
16 wall + 4 plastic PMTs (+2 LS) + 2–3 trigger-word + spares. A V1742 (32 ch) covers it; or 2 × V1730. '10–20 channels we could find'.

hardware.part: Trigger: 2–3 N1081B, timer, FIFOs, NIM bin
hardware.note: n_TOF logic for two arms: PAIR never prescaled, SINGLE ÷P, 1 Hz clock, trigger word, scalers, busy veto.
No mixer comes from n_TOF. Flammable-gas rules at LNL: ask. Low-permeation lines (Synflex type) are a low-budget upgrade; slot 1 can run on standard lines.
Low-budget upgrade: T/p/RH, SHT85 cells on the gas line, logger (slow_control/SENSOR_OPTIONS.md §6).
LNL rolls Li to 10–20 µm in an Ar glovebox and presses it onto Cu. 10–12 µm recommended (LiOH). Holder: flat Al end cap at 45° (proposed) or the Cu ogive.
Two opposite arms, faces at ±204 mm from the beam axis; the line must end in ~1.5 × 1.5 m of open floor.
Run control from n_TOF. A switched PDU on the NIM bin (remote power cycles) is a low-budget upgrade.

budget.item: Gas and environment sensors (slow control Tier 1)
4 CERN M1 cards for B (B runs its Italian M1s for the test)
If no digitizer loan: V1742 (32 ch)
If no VME crate: VME8004B + A4818
If the PMTs must be bought: 4–6 fast 2″ PMTs + bases

questions.q: Spokesperson(s) and GLIMOS for the abstract page? (GLIMOS is normally local.)
AN2000 or CN? The CN starts at 0.8 MV, so no 441 keV calibration there; AN2000 runs 0.2–2.0 MV self-service.
Which target and holder for the proposal (pressed Li on Cu; flat Al end cap at 45° or the Cu ogive)?
Arm orientation: a horizontal pair (cosmics suppressed by geometry, best reach) or a vertical pair (the hard test of the veto)? Can the stand rotate between runs?
'Commission II': which INFN commission, and when must the request be in? Results before that date?
Is the H2-2027 window flexible to June–July, so that results exist before the funding requests?
Author list: affiliations for Massimi, Mengoni, Gervino, Gustavino, Cosentino; anyone else (n_TOF, CEA, Torino)?
A line on AN2000 (or CN) ending in ~1.5 × 1.5 m of free floor; beam height; 1 µA at 0.441 and 1.10 MeV on that line?
Is a PAC 'day' 24 h? Night and weekend running with self-service AN2000?
Flammable premix (Ar/iC₄H₁₀ 95/5) in the hall: rules, storage, exhaust.
Fix B's drift + 2 windows by April 2027? Lend 4 FEUs + TCM for Jun–Oct 2027?
A test loan of a V1742 or 2 × V1730 + 2 N1081B for the run (Pierfrancesco's suggestion)?
Status of their 2023–24 AN2000 data; is a joint or complementary run welcome; is the AN2000 room free?
Can we borrow the 4 small plastics' PMTs again (or which PMTs fit them)?

risks.r: Micromegas B or the windows not ready
risks.m: A is ready now; C re-bulk as the spare; one-arm-plus-scintillator fallback still gives the 441 keV and background programme.

risks.r: DREAM not available in H2 2027 (CEA's own use)
risks.m: Ask now (M2); 4 FEUs is half the system; fix dates with CEA before the PAC talk.
Two arms need ~24, PM can find 10–20; CAEN loan; ganged walls keep it at 8 per wall.

risks.r: AN2000 room occupied (LNL ⁸Be spectrometer) or no free line
risks.m: Talk to the Marchi group first; CN fallback (no 441 keV; 1.03–1.10 only).
Frame as feasibility: measured rates, backgrounds, calibration. X17 sensitivity is a bonus, quoted as an expected limit.
10–12 µm films; γ-yield monitor each day; a spare film; a week's conversion test before the run.

risks.r: Machine-future decision (one machine to replace AN2000 + CN)
risks.m: Run in 2027 is unaffected; follow the decision (x17_facility_search/lnl/NOTE_CN_AN2000_REPLACEMENT.md).

risks.r: Proposal deadline missed (next call ~a year later)
risks.m: Draft by 27 Nov; submit 9 Dec; get the INFN-AAI account this week.

rules: Use the LNL templates (abstract + body, LaTeX or Word); submit PDF only. Abstract: one page (not counted in the body)
Abstract fields: title, accelerator, set-up, spokesperson(s), GLIMOS, all authors + affiliations, short summary
Body: max 4 pages per the official template (the LNL web page says 5), 12 pt, tables + figures + references included
Body must contain: scientific motivation; technical details (instrumentation, quantities measured, precision); beam days from count-rate estimates
Online: Beam Time Request, then the Targets Request Form; keep the confirmation e-mail (password)
Needs an active INFN-AAI account with 'Risorse IT'
Internal LNL technical review before the PAC (beam, target, set-up readiness, radioprotection, safety); issues sent ~7 days before
Possible oral presentation: 12 min + 8 min discussion, hybrid

slot2.name: Slot 2: the ⁸Be X17 measurement
setup: Four arms: A, B + re-bulked C and D, new windows on all
Big plastics (4 × ~78 × 80 × 5 cm in-house plates) behind the SiPM walls: ×13–15 in running time
SiPM walls per bar end (FERS, 160 ch) in the Upgrade preset; ganged in Self
Own trigger/DAQ (architecture B or D), DREAM still from CEA
Target from the slot-1 experience (flat Al end cap / Cu ogive, 10–12 µm Li)
programme: 441 keV calibration (17.64 MeV, no anomaly expected)
3σ at R(ATOMKI) at 1.10 MeV, then 0.80 and 1.225 MeV off-resonance (clean points need 5–10 µm films)
Big plastics: 4.4 d (Al + Cu liner) to 12 d (Cu ogive) for the programme; as built 23–80 d

beam.what: Beam on target at low current; target conditioning; current scan 0.05 → 1 µA: trigger rates, DREAM live time, Micromegas occupancy, SiPM/plastic singles
Locate the 441 keV resonance on the γ yield (17.64 MeV, M1); IPC calibration run
IPC calibration run: opening-angle resolution, acceptance, energy scale against Geant4
18.15 MeV region: IPC spectrum, X17 window
18.15 MeV region (cont.); end-of-run target check (γ yield vs day 4)
18.15 MeV region (cont.), or 0.80 MeV off-resonance if the target allows; contingency
Beam-off cosmic runs with the full trigger: the cosmic background model, measured
